description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2000/39, Kesbewa  & other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains multiple entries detailing specific amendments to land parcel registrations, including expunging particulars, inserting parcel numbers, extents, and owner information for various land parcels in different locations. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land title matters, making it a clear example of Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
